Journey from junior sysadmin to principal devops engineer began in 2015, navigating from on-prem infrastructure to cloud-native architectures. Early roles in media tech laid groundwork for understanding scalability challenges, which evolved into leadership roles shaping AdVerve’s infrastructure roadmap.  

Current Focus centers on architecting resilient, cost-effective systems at scale. Driving AWS-native solutions that integrate with Kubernetes clusters, while optimizing Terraform workflows to streamline multi-cloud adoption. Mentorship remains a priority, fostering growth in teams that manage high-availability ad-tech platforms.  

Skills Highlight includes designing CI/CD pipelines that cut deployment times by 40% for real-time bidding systems. Linux expertise powers automation in load-balanced environments, ensuring sub-100ms response times. Prometheus/Grafana dashboards have slashed incident resolution times by 30%, while AWS and Kubernetes foundations underpin 90% of our infrastructure. Terraform mastery enables rapid environment provisioning, reducing onboarding friction for new engineers.  

Let’s connect if you’re building scalable systems or navigating cloud transitions—collaboration often accelerates growth.
